messages:
Maya (PM): BigRetail requested onboarding of a finetuned Llama sha and wants a 3-month pin. Constraints: p95 <=120ms @512 tokens; rerank parity with our reference. Can we outline a fast, negotiable plan?
Raj (Eng): Need their eval subset + 48h traffic dump. If fp16 quantized, kernel perf pass likely. Confirm KV cache semantics for long-lived chats.
Sam (CSE): Asking for the data now. They said a 2-week grace migration is acceptable. I'll push for a reserved capacity commit but customer values predictability.
Ana (ML): My gating proposal: 1) rerank delta <=2% vs baseline; 2) NER hallucination <=baseline; 3) p95 latency <=1.3x of verified profile (block if >1.5x); 4) embedding similarity delta <0.02. Any fail blocks hard pin.
Leo (SRE): Hard pin = reserve Dedicated pool + higher ops overhead. We need rollback SLAs, canary calendar slot, and autoscale guardrails. Soft pin allows fallback under overload.
Raj (Eng): Pin policy draft: soft-pin = route to requested sha but allow system fallback; hard-pin = always route to sha and reserve capacity. Default soft unless paid. I'll add catalog perf fields: model_sha, quant, fp_type, p95_512, mem_gb, kv_notes.
Maya (PM): Negotiation path: offer 90d soft pin + migration runway; upgrade to hard pin if customer signs reserved capacity within 14 days. Sam to negotiate.
Ana (ML): I'll run onramp suite (QA exact-match, rerank AUC, perplexity on domain, latency). ETA 48h.
Leo (SRE): Proposed rollout: 5% for 6h -> 25% for 12h -> 100% with monitors (latency_p95, rerank_delta, error_rate). Auto-rollback if rerank drift >2% or 5xx_rate spike >0.5%.
Raj (Eng): Example rollout snippet: rollout phases 5%/6h, 25%/12h, 100%/24h; fallback: soft_fallback: true.
Maya (PM): Decision: proceed with 90d soft pin, run onramp + canary, present reserved capacity offer to upgrade to hard pin. Owners: Maya (track), Raj (routing), Ana (eval), Leo (ops), Sam (customer).
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled for 1932100900 (5% traffic)  will post progress to #eng-runtime during the window.
Sam (CSE): Customer update: likely to accept 90d soft pin given migration plan; will respond on the reserved offer within 48h.
Maya (PM): I'll add notes to the onboarding ticket and include pin_ttl and pin_type fields in the PRD. Review in Monday roadmap sync. Thanks team :thumbsup:
